request.prompt: Photoreal precision industrial product visualization with crisp machined edges, clearly resolved fine screws, bearing rings and brushed-metal surface detail across the entire arm. Deep focus, no soft focus, no motion blur, no bloom or diffusion. A single completely locked-off tripod shot of the exact six-axis industrial robotic arm in the start reference transitioning to the exact exploded configuration in the end reference. Preserve the rectangular mounting base at exactly the same pixel location, main supporting arm structure, plain dark background, floor, warm key light, camera framing, angle, exposure and scale. Hold assembled for 0.4 seconds; from 0.4 to 4.8 seconds separate only the existing covers, fasteners, shafts, bearings and wrist components along their local mechanical axes into evenly spaced end-reference positions; hold the exploded final state to the end. Controlled smooth rigid-body translation, stable fine detail from frame to frame. No camera motion, zoom, whole-arm rotation, cuts, reverse cycle, extra parts, geometry melting/bending, text, logos, particles, smoke, sparks, music or narration. Illustrative engineering concept, one forward transition only.

output.encode: libx264 preset slow crf 20 g 4 keyint_min 4 sc_threshold 0 bf 0 yuv420p; metadata stripped
